note: User-visible strings the site assembles at runtime. They appear in no .html file on disk, so without this list the dictionary coverage gate in scripts/build-site-data.js would report them as dead entries. `verify` holds literal fragments that must still exist in `source`; the gate re-checks them on every build, which is what stops this list from outliving the copy it describes. Regenerate the candidate strings by rendering the site with: node scripts/extract-i18n-strings.js --json out.json
